name: Retractable Table Top banner 33"W X 40"
description: A retractable table top display can display your company or personal message in seconds for any trade show, college fair, community gathering or small business venture. Featuring a full-color custom printed 33"W X 40"H banner, the poster pulls up from the base of the unit and can be displayed in seconds by connecting the banner to a vertical support bar. Printed banner, aluminum stand and convenient canvas carrying bag are included with the purchase of the display.
